SELECT st.id AS apStatementId, st.source_order_id AS sourceOrderId, st.source_order_no AS sourceOrderNo, pin.id AS sourcePurchaseInId, pin.no AS sourcePurchaseInNo, pii.id AS sourcePurchaseInItemId, st.supplier_id AS supplierId, pii.product_id AS productId, st.biz_date AS bizDate, pii.count AS totalCount, IFNULL(SUM(match_item.match_count), 0) AS matchedCount, GREATEST(pii.count - IFNULL(SUM(match_item.match_count), 0), 0) AS remainCount, pii.total_price AS totalAmount, IFNULL(SUM(match_item.match_amount), 0) AS matchedAmount, GREATEST(pii.total_price - IFNULL(SUM(match_item.match_amount), 0), 0) AS remainAmount FROM erp_ap_statement st INNER JOIN erp_purchase_in pin ON pin.id = st.biz_id AND pin.deleted = 0 INNER JOIN erp_purchase_in_items pii ON pii.in_id = pin.id AND pii.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN erp_ap_invoice_match_item match_item ON match_item.source_purchase_in_item_id = pii.id AND match_item.status = #{activeStatus} AND match_item.deleted = 0 WHERE st.deleted = 0 AND st.biz_type = #{purchaseInBizType} AND st.status != #{closedStatus} AND st.supplier_id = #{supplierId}
AND pin.no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{reqVO.purchaseInNo}, '%')
AND st.source_order_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{reqVO.sourceOrderNo}, '%')
GROUP BY st.id, st.source_order_id, st.source_order_no, pin.id, pin.no, pii.id, st.supplier_id, pii.product_id, st.biz_date, pii.count, pii.total_price HAVING remainCount > 0 OR remainAmount > 0 ORDER BY st.biz_date DESC, pii.id DESC
